eventDetail.scope: The purpose of this conference is the exchange of experience and the latest achievements of scientists from Russia and abroad on topical microwave issues. The most relevant areas are the use of microwave, EHF, and terahertz ranges of electromagnetic waves in engineering, medicine, security systems and many other areas, as well as the development of materials with new properties for use in microwave technology. Substantial attention will be paid to the creation of an element base for advanced communication, radar and radio-vision systems based on the achievements of radio electronics, micro- and nanoelectronics.   Conference topics: - Propagation and scattering of electromagnetic waves - Antenna systems and transmission lines - Generators, amplifiers, receiving devices - Microwave and THz bands - New materials for electronics - Measuring systems, including medicine Radars and remote sensing - Radio communication - Signal Processing
